notes.title: Level Unknown: Backrooms Demo Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone,[/h1]

We are excited to announce that the demo for Level Unknown: Backrooms is now available on Steam!

This is early access. In this demo, you will get a taste of what to expect in the full game. You will explore for example the Level 0 lobby of the Backrooms, a mysterious and unsettling place where reality seems to have broken down. You will need to use your wits and courage to survive in this hostile environment.

[h3]The demo includes:[/h3]

A large and detailed 2 levels to explore
A variety of puzzles to solve
A tense and atmospheric experience
We hope you enjoy the demo! Please let us know what you think in the comments below. 
If you find any bugs, please report them on the game's Discord. 
https://discord.gg/3xESYcYTSQ?event=1182020868373762069

[h2]Steam Demo:[/h2] https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700560/Level_Unknown_Backrooms/

notes.title: #CHANGELOG v0.32.0 (DEMO)
notes.content:
[h1]#CHANGELOG v0.32.0 (DEMO)[/h1]

Game mechanics:
- Added the ability to change keybinds

Improvements:
The appearance of the Lobby (Level 2) has been significantly improved
- The size of the key on the tree has been increased
- The game's intuitiveness has been improved
- The vacuum cleaner is quieter
- Footstep sounds are quieter
- Animations in the inventory have been sped up
- Improved dynamic lighting in the hospital

Bugs: 
- The levitating battery was moved
- Fixed backshroom collision
- Radio sounds are now quieter
- Fixed numerous fatal errors
- Fixed sanity effects
- Fixed first person camera animations
    - jumping
    - climbing
    - crouching
    - hit
- Fixed double credits
- Fixed numerous crashes


Game balance:
- Entity in construction deals more damage
